# Process and frame as readings of one unfolding

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> The move is read within the configuration, a world's moves being its relata's exchanges; a history is a run of the law it shows, the correspondence not an identity, the gap being memory; a claim is a relatum.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Let P be a process on configurations S with moves A. Read with the move inside the configuration (withMove P, on S × A with one label), P's runs are one run read two ways (Run.toWithMove, Run.ofWithMove, Run.ofWithMove_toWithMove, Run.toWithMove_ofWithMove); the law then leaves the next move open (withMove_open), and it is determined exactly where P is determined and, wherever P takes a step, only one move exists (withMove_determined_iff). Where the move is formed by a policy of the configuration (closedBy P policy), each step is a step of the law with the move left open (closedBy_withMove); a determined P stays determined (closedBy_determined), and two runs from one configuration agree at every step (closedBy_runs_agree, through GoAlike.runs_agree of Becoming.Mechanism). Forgetting the move of a joint step of GenerativeCore's productProcess leaves a step of each part with its move forgotten (unlabelled_product_le); in Fork two parts forking by one law cannot go different ways at once with the move shared, and can with the move forgotten in each part first (Fork.label_couples). In a world w the move across the step from t is its relata's exchange (Exchange, World.move): what the relata present take and give. The law of exchange (exchange R) says that each relatum's standing after a step with what is taken from it equals its standing before with what is given to it. w balances exactly where its standings run by this law with its exchanges as moves (World.balances_iff_exchange, by definition), across one step exactly where it balances on every family there (World.exchange_step_iff), and is then a run of the law (World.exchangeRun). The law fixes each standing after a step (exchange_agrees); two runs with the same moves, starting alike at every relatum, agree at every relatum at every step (exchange_runs_agree); in Circulation a circulation and no exchange leave the same standings (Labelled.Circulation.standings_leave_exchange), and runs with the same moves from different starts differ at every step (Labelled.Circulation.start_needed). For any sequence of configurations g and moves m, the law it shows (Shown g m) has exactly its steps; the sequence is a run of it (Shown.run), it is the least law the sequence is a run of (shown_le_iff), and it lies within every law of which a run has these configurations and moves (Run.shown_le). Shown g m is determined exactly where the sequence is consistent, never taking one move at one configuration to two outcomes (Consistent, shown_determined_iff), and exactly then some determined law admits the sequence (exists_law_iff, through carries_law_iff and goAlike_id_iff of Becoming.Mechanism); every determined law admitting it agrees with it on its steps (Shown.agrees). The correspondence is not an identity: in DeadEnd a law has a step and no run (DeadEnd.no_history); in Splice a history that revisits a configuration shows a law admitting a run that is the history from no step on (Splice.spliced); where a sequence never revisits, every run of the law it shows from one of its configurations is the sequence from there on (eq_of_new, Shown.runs_of_new), so along a run keeping its history (keepHistory of Becoming.Experiment) the law it shows admits only it (Run.keepHistory_shown). For a frame F and a run r, F.world r is a world whose relata are F's claims, each active exactly where realized, with no flow and nothing standing, depending or drawing (Frame.world, Frame.world_active); a claim arises exactly where it comes to be realized (Frame.arises_iff); where the configuration after a step records what was realized before it, a claim of a reading is new after the step exactly where one arises across it (Frame.novel_iff_arises); in a finite family of claims decided at each step, coming to be realized recurs exactly where ceasing to be realized recurs (Frame.claims_recur_iff, by coming_recurs_iff of Becoming.Change). With the configurations as claims (Frame.configurations), two runs whose worlds agree in activity agree at every step (Frame.world_fixes_run). No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Unfolding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Unfolding.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise; each theorem's local conditions are written into it: exists_law_iff and shown_determined_iff are two-way and hold of every sequence; closedBy_runs_agree needs P determined and the same start; exchange_runs_agree needs the same moves and starts alike at every relatum; Shown.runs_of_new needs the sequence never to revisit; Frame.novel_iff_arises needs the configuration after a step to record what was realized before it; Frame.claims_recur_iff needs a finite list of claims decided at each step.
- Reading the move within the configuration, and the policy forming the move, are readings supplied; that a move is formed within the unfolding, or by what, is not derived; the law of exchange reads a world's flow as its moves.
- A law is a determined process (Determined of Becoming.Joint); runs are infinite (Run of Becoming.Frame), so a law's step into a dead end lies on no run.
- For the witnesses: the processes, sequences and runs of Fork, Splice, DeadEnd and Circulation.
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number amounts; a shared index of steps; in Frame.world the claims form a type in Type, as World's relata do.

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked of the core's first two layers “is this dualistic?”, and to the AI's answer (they posit no subject and object, but their form takes four splits as given: a configuration and a move from an alphabet of its own, a law prior to the history, claims read off a configuration, and configurations prior to their relation; the proposal was to restate them from World, leaving GenerativeCore unchanged) answered “yes, put it on the board and start” (work-board item P69). On another branch of the same conversation, of the reading that law and history are one unfolding read two ways, the law read off the unfolding rather than set over it, Ren wrote “yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”. The results on DeadEnd, Splice, kept history, Fork and Circulation restate on this module's definitions theorems checked on that branch. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): World is where the core begins, a labelled process is the reading that splits the configuration into what the law fixes and what it leaves open, and a frame is a world read through its claims; an agent's choice is not a second kind of cause beside the unfolding, and varying one's own act is varying what the configuration is; the gap between a law and its histories is memory: a law answers from where one is, not from how one came there; knowing is within the unfolding, a claim coming to be and ceasing under the same laws as anything else. See §91 of the integration note.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §91 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

The shared index of steps is a commitment of the representation and is not derived from relations (see Becoming.Sampling and Becoming.Tower); that a move is formed within the unfolding, or by what, and which law a formation takes its history to show, are not derived; a law means a determined process, and probabilities are not treated; GenerativeCore is unchanged and still states processes in labelled form, so what is given here is a reading and a bridge, not another foundation; Frame.world has no flow or web, and relations among claims are not stated; most main theorems are near-definitional, the delta being that both directions are proved, where the correspondence fails to be an identity, and its price; the readings are the AI's, Ren having confirmed the reading of law and history and approved readings in context; contains no ethical predicate.

- Law to histories loses: in DeadEnd a law has a step and no run at all (DeadEnd.no_history). [Unfolding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Unfolding.lean)
- History to law gains: in Splice the history revisits its start, and the law it shows admits a run going back and forth between the first two configurations, which is the history from no step on (Splice.spliced). [Unfolding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Unfolding.lean)
- A shared move is a relation between parts: in Fork, with each part's move forgotten first, the two can go different ways at once (Fork.label_couples). [Unfolding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Unfolding.lean)
- Standings do not fix the exchange, and the exchange fixes standings only from a beginning: in Circulation a circulation and no exchange leave the same standings, and runs with the same moves from different starts differ everywhere (Labelled.Circulation.standings_leave_exchange, Labelled.Circulation.start_needed). [Unfolding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Unfolding.lean)

## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [space-and-its-parts](space-and-its-parts.md). Reuses World, Flow.Balances, Flow.BalancesOn and Web.Arises: a world's moves are read as its relata's exchanges, and balance is running by the law of exchange; a frame along a run is read as a world, a claim's arising being Web.Arises.
- **formal-reuse**: [projection-carrying-a-law](projection-carrying-a-law.md). Reuses carries_law_iff and goAlike_id_iff: some determined law admits a history exactly where it is consistent (exists_law_iff), Shown g m being the least process it factors through; reuses GoAlike.runs_agree: with the move formed within, runs agree (closedBy_runs_agree).
- **formal-reuse**: [experiment-needs-return](experiment-needs-return.md). Reuses keepHistory and keepHistory_new: a run keeping its history never revisits, so the law it shows admits only it (Run.keepHistory_shown). What a law supplied before the history adds is its moves not taken, which the record does not fix (Run.not_fixes_of_untaken, cited in the reading).
- **formal-reuse**: [joint-difference-making](joint-difference-making.md). Reuses Determined: a law is a determined process; determinacy with the move inside (withMove_determined_iff), and of the law a history shows (shown_determined_iff).
- **formal-reuse**: [coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace](coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace.md). Reuses ComesToBe, CeasesToBe, Recurs and coming_recurs_iff: claims are relata, and coming to be realized recurs exactly where ceasing to be realized recurs (Frame.claims_recur_iff).

**Output:** The world: relata, flow and web; balance, and balance on a family at a step; arising.

**Preserved conditions:** None. [World.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/World.lean)

**Input:** Determinacy of the law a history shows; runs with the move formed within.

**Preserved conditions:** None (the identity as the projection). [Mechanism.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)


**Output:** The process keeping its history; a kept history is new at every step.

**Input:** The correspondence of law and history where the history is kept.

**Preserved conditions:** None. [Experiment.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Experiment.lean)


**Output:** Determinacy.

**Input:** What a law means.

**Preserved conditions:** None. [Joint.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joint.lean)

**Input:** The laws of activity for claims.

**Preserved conditions:** A finite list of claims, decided at each step. [Change.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Change.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [configurations-alike-by-relation](configurations-alike-by-relation.md). The fourth item in the same module: a configuration is how it relates; under the law of exchange standings are alike exactly where they agree at every relatum.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). The price of keeping the history: Law.withHistory_never_returns and withHistory_unlisted, a kept history never returns and no list holds it. That the law admits only the kept history (Run.keepHistory_shown) and that it never returns are two sides of one fact.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [trace-law-equivalence](trace-law-equivalence.md). Periphery: two processes on the same state and move types agree step by step exactly where they agree on all finite labelled traces with both endpoints. Here the subject is one infinite history and the law it shows: the least law, and where the correspondence is not an identity.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [derived-history-law-exactness](derived-history-law-exactness.md). Periphery: the local law built from a language of finite histories and a summary keeps every finite continuation exactly where histories sharing a code have the same continuations. Shown.runs_of_new is a case in the core: where the configuration never repeats, the law shown admits only the history.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [identity-across-steps](identity-across-steps.md). Labels carry nothing; here the move read as a label into the configuration loses nothing, while a move shared between parts is a relation (Fork.label_couples).
- Related, not a proved adapter: [causal-models-as-processes](causal-models-as-processes.md). In standard causal models the move is the input and the noise; here, with the move read within the configuration, they are what the law leaves open, and with a policy forming them within the law stays determined.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [counterfactual-is-the-course](counterfactual-is-the-course.md). Instances (P80b): the course of a law of exchange is a world, running by the law of exchange exactly where feasible; a determined law's steps beyond Shown are exactly at the moves the run never takes (Run.beyond_shown_iff, a law about Shown, kept in Counterfactual for now), so what lies beyond the course's history is its counterfactuals; with the part's move formed by a law on the configuration, a run of closedBy is the course.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [unity-of-readings](unity-of-readings.md). Whatever reads an unfolding is a reading in context, and the readings are always one world (Contextual.world, as Frame.world); World is the glued reading, and with the rest counted every world is one run of the law of exchange (World.unity), which drops the balance premise of World.exchangeRun. Ren approved the readings in context as the general case and World as the glued case, the process and the frame being readings of one unfolding.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [where-a-move-is-formed](where-a-move-is-formed.md). Advances its next step: a move can always be read as formed within a whole (Run.withClock: its rest forms it), and is the part's own exactly where it is formed through the part's configuration (PartForms); the coupled whole is the product's closedBy (Run.toClosedBy, Run.ofClosedBy); one course fixes whose move it is only where a configuration recurs with the move varied.

<a id="复用与下一增量-reuse-and-next-delta"></a>
